transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Could I have technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads each report their final operating requirements? I want to make sure we address any remaining issues before I sign off on the package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding from my RF survey. Wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop, so the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but it's not on Mara's draft lock sheet yet, so we need to get that updated before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical rights issue to report. My signed performance license permits the gala broadcast but prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I received the countersigned license this morning and have not yet entered the restriction in the rights tracker. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive, which would constitute a video-on-demand release. We need to remove the festival archive reuse from the package before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a critical talent issue to report. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not reflected in the production schedule. The soundcheck time constraint needs to be added to the schedule, and the sponsor product display on stage directly conflicts with the headliner's rider and must be removed before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility requirement to report. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for captioning. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. We need to get Booth B assigned for captioning on the lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
